metadata.description: Curated sources for production prompt engineering: provider-native prompt ops, structured outputs, evaluation/regression testing, tool/RAG prompting, security, and observability.
metadata.title: AI Prompt Engineering - Sources

standards_and_security.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
standards_and_security.relevance: Threat categories and mitigations for prompt injection, data leakage, and tool misuse.

standards_and_security.name: OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
standards_and_security.relevance: Step-by-step prevention techniques for prompt injection with defense-in-depth patterns.

standards_and_security.name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026
standards_and_security.relevance: Finalized OWASP framework for agentic AI threats (ASI01-ASI10: goal hijack, tool misuse, identity/privilege abuse, supply chain, unexpected code execution, memory/context poisoning, insecure inter-agent comms, cascading failures, human-agent trust exploitation, rogue agents). Parallel to OWASP LLM Top 10, not replacing it.

standards_and_security.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
standards_and_security.relevance: Governance baseline for risk assessment, controls, and documentation that affect prompts, logging, and evaluations.

standards_and_security.name: NIST Generative AI Profile (AI 600-1)
standards_and_security.relevance: GenAI-specific profile aligned to NIST AI RMF; useful for prompt safety and monitoring control mapping.

standards_and_security.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
standards_and_security.relevance: Regulatory baseline for transparency and documentation requirements that often affect prompt logging and outputs.

standards_and_security.name: JSON Schema
standards_and_security.relevance: Schema standard for structured outputs, tool I/O validation, and contract testing.

standards_and_security.name: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for GenAI
standards_and_security.relevance: Experimental telemetry conventions for tokens, latency, and model metadata needed for prompt monitoring and regression detection.

prompt_and_tool_use_research.name: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
prompt_and_tool_use_research.relevance: Foundational prompting technique; useful historical context for when private reasoning may help.

prompt_and_tool_use_research.name: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
prompt_and_tool_use_research.relevance: Core pattern for tool use; informs agent/tool prompting and error handling structure.

prompt_and_tool_use_research.name: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning
prompt_and_tool_use_research.relevance: Reference for sampling-based reliability improvements; use cautiously with cost controls.

prompt_and_tool_use_research.name: Toolformer
prompt_and_tool_use_research.relevance: Reference for learning tool-use behaviors and understanding tool-calling error modes.

prompt_and_tool_use_research.name: Constitutional AI
prompt_and_tool_use_research.relevance: Reference for safety-aligned behavior via explicit principles; useful for policy scaffolding patterns.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Prompting Guide
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary OpenAI guide for prompt design, prompt structure, and reasoning/task framing.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Structured Outputs
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for schema-first structured outputs and strict JSON contracts.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Evals
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for provider-native evaluation workflows and prompt regression testing.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Graders
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for score-based evaluation and rubric/LLM judging patterns.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Evaluation Getting Started
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for datasets, evaluation setup, and getting started with prompt eval loops.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Prompt Optimizer
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Provider-native prompt improvement workflow for finding stronger prompt candidates before manual editing.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: OpenAI Prompt Caching
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for caching stable prompt prefixes and reducing prompt-operating cost.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Prompt Engineering Overview
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary Anthropic overview for prompt engineering patterns and workflow framing.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Prompting Tools
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Provider-native prompt tooling surface for templates, generation, improvement, and prompt operations.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Claude Prompting Best Practices
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary Anthropic best-practices reference for clear instructions, XML tags, examples, and evaluation habits.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Eval Tool
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Provider-native evaluation surface for tracking prompt/model quality before release.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Define Success and Build Evals
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for success criteria, eval design, and rollout gating on Anthropic.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Anthropic Adaptive Thinking
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Current Anthropic guidance for model-native thinking behavior — adaptive thinking is the only supported thinking-on mode for Claude Opus 4.7.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Claude Opus 4.8 — What's New
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for Opus 4.8: same API contract as 4.7 (no breaking changes), new features (mid-conversation system messages, refusal stop_details, lower 1024-token cache minimum, fast mode research preview), effort default now 'high' on all surfaces, improved tool triggering and long-context agentic quality.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Claude Opus 4.7 — What's New
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for Opus 4.7 breaking changes (budget_tokens removed, sampling params removed, thinking omitted by default), new features (adaptive thinking, xhigh effort, task budgets, 2576px images, 1:1 coordinates), and new tokenizer specs.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Introducing Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Launch announcement for Fable 5 (GA June 9, 2026; always-on adaptive thinking; 1M context; 128k output; $10/$50 per MTok; safety-classifier fallback to Opus 4.8 in <5% of sessions) and Mythos 5 (Project Glasswing, research-access only).

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Redeploying Claude Fable 5
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Fable 5 was suspended for all users June 12, 2026 after US export controls followed a jailbreak disclosure, then redeployed globally July 1, 2026 with a tightened safety classifier that flags more benign coding requests. Load-bearing for prompt-contract resilience planning: do not treat Mythos-class model availability as a stable dependency; re-baseline refusal-rate evals after any provider-side classifier update.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: XGrammar — Structured Output Engine
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Open-source grammar-constrained decoding engine used for structured output in self-hosted inference stacks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM). Verify default status per framework version before relying on it.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: DSPy — Programming with Foundation Models
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Automatic prompt optimization framework. MIPROv2 optimizer proposes and searches better instructions for multi-step pipelines given a metric and labeled data.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Google Gemini Prompting Strategies
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary Google guide for prompt design, parameter tuning, and current model-specific prompting guidance.

vendor_docs_and_guides.name: Google Gemini Structured Output
vendor_docs_and_guides.relevance: Primary source for schema-constrained outputs on Gemini.

operator_content.name: Why AI evals are the hottest new skill for product builders | Hamel Husain & Shreya Shankar (Lenny's Podcast)
operator_content.relevance: PM-oriented eval guidance: error analysis workflows, eval prompts as living PRDs, and why rigorous evals remain essential for AI product quality.

operator_content.name: AI prompt engineering in 2025: What works and what doesn't | Sander Schulhoff (Lenny's Podcast)
operator_content.relevance: Current-state overview of prompt engineering effectiveness, covering what techniques still work and where teams waste effort.

evaluation_and_testing.name: Promptfoo - Prompt Testing Framework
evaluation_and_testing.relevance: Declarative prompt testing with CI/CD integration, red teaming, and side-by-side comparison.

evaluation_and_testing.name: DeepEval - LLM Evaluation Framework
evaluation_and_testing.relevance: Python-native evaluation framework for unit tests, red teaming, and LLM quality gates.

evaluation_and_testing.name: OpenAI Cookbook
evaluation_and_testing.relevance: Practical examples for structured outputs, tool calling, prompt optimization, and evaluation patterns.

evaluation_and_testing.name: LangSmith Documentation
evaluation_and_testing.relevance: Example observability/eval tooling for prompts and traces across prompt workflows.
